## Einträge

### 2050-01-01 · Multitenancy supported in Alibaba Cloud data center

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Multitenancy · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 593344770*

Multitenancy in SAP HANA Cloud natively provides tenant-aware data management features. It is now supported in the Alibaba Cloud data center.  
Note that Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) are not supported.  
See: [SAP HANA Cloud Multitenancy Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_CN/80402af83be54ff39ab39915224c0c0b/172f93968dfe45f09bf8c14b2ca9582d.html)  

### 2026-12-31 · Replica Support for ESS Alerts and Collectors

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Alerts and Notifications · Version: 2026.40 (QRC 4/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry, Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595244588*

The Embedded Statistics Service (ESS) supports asynchronous and synchronous replicas for a subset of customer-facing alerts and collectors. Where supported, replica coverage is activated automatically. See [Replica Support for ESS Alerts and Collectors](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-embedded-statistics-service-catalog-sys-statistics-reference/embedded-statistics-service-sys-vr-replica-schema).  

### 2026-10-21 · Request capacity for 12TB instance on Azure

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077120*

Before provisioning an SAP HANA database instance with a memory size of 12 TB on Azure, you must complete an additional step to pre-reserve the required hardware needed for your instance. Once the pre-reservation process is complete, you can proceed with provisioning the instance. For more information, see SAP Note [3717342](https://me.sap.com/notes/3717342).  

### 2026-10-21 · Multiple Issuer DNs for X.509 Providers

*Area: Security · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077125*

SAP HANA Cloud Central now lets you configure multiple issuer DNs for a single X.509 provider. When creating or editing a provider, you can add or remove issuers using a certificate file, PEM string, or a certificate from the store. The issuer DN is extracted automatically.  
See:  
- [Add an X.509 Identity Provider](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/35f103e2f81f46ef8409d6125f6dd2e9.html)  
- [Identity Providers Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/e4e1a97b76fb4ad6b00031dfdc06cafc.html)  
- [X.509 Certificate-Based User Authentication](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/2b335f7eec6a450095f110ea961d77cc.html)  

### 2026-10-21 · Instance-Specific Certificates and DNS Configuration

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077142*

You can now configure instance-specific DNS and certificates directly from SAP HANA Cloud Central.  
See [SAP HANA Database Configuration](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/e4b6b571863446f496a0476f6407abda.html).  

### 2026-10-21 · Enhanced Audit Policy Features

*Area: Security · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077124*

SAP HANA Cloud Central now lets you limit selected data definition actions to specific schemas, or audit data manipulation actions on an object across all schemas by omitting the schema during object selection. A policy must target either specific schemas or all schemas, but not both.  
See:  
- [Audit Policies](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/db4b4fb4bb571014a22b8f893c94aeef.html)  
- [Auditing Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c6c1dbc66caa41499f173220503aec94.html)  

### 2026-10-21 · Data Points Metric in the Consumption Monitor

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077114*

SAP HANA Cloud now tracks SAP-RPT-TS tabular foundation model consumption as data points, a new usage-based billing unit. Data points are visible in the Consumption Monitor alongside memory, compute, storage, and network data transfer.  
See [Consumption Monitor in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/consumption-monitor).  

### 2026-10-13 · Database objects browser

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Multitenancy · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077115*

Access the Open in Database Objects browser directly from the schema or HDI container page and establish a connection using the latest credential.  
See: [Managing SAP HANA Cloud Database Tenants](3ce1a923e4284486987d9b93e140471d.html)  

### 2026-10-13 · Aggregated resource usage

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Multitenancy · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077116*

The memory consumption can be displayed including dropped tenants (Total Memory Consumption) and excluding dropped tenants (Memory Consumption).  
See: [Managing SAP HANA Cloud Database Tenants](3ce1a923e4284486987d9b93e140471d.html)  

### 2026-10-07 · SQL Script Analyzer in Database Objects

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077119*

Function and Procedure detail view now contains an additional tab called SQL Script Analysis. In this tab, you can select Analyze SQL Script to run the analysis and populate a table of issues.  

### 2026-10-07 · Import and Export RDF Files

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077126*

SAP HANA Cloud Central now supports importing data from RDF files and exporting RDF knowledge graph catalog objects to RDF files. RDF is available as a data type in the create import and export wizards, with support for SAP Data Lake Files, Azure Storage, Amazon S3, and Google Cloud Storage.  
See:  
- [Using Import and Export in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/de125916128447f98cde25f14c2e59d2.html)  
- [Importing Data in HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/c9ca5258054e49a48f111808ceb96d2b.html)  
- [Exporting Data in HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/42e2d2997424491aa23bdeb52b311277.html)  

### 2026-10-07 · Data Access Agent alerts

*Area: Monitoring · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077121*

The Alerts app now supports Data Access Agent instances. You can view alerts for your Data Access Agent instances and enable or disable alert rules for these instances. Data Access Agent instances appear in the instance filter grouped under the HANA database instance they're associated with.  
See [Using Alerts in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/b8cc733919ff40eb8725ef47316c840b.html).  

### 2026-10-07 · Cookie Consent Banner Removal

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077123*

The cookie consent banner has been removed. Usage data is now collected by default. You can opt out of cookie collection in the Settings dialog. The Functional Cookies toggle is in the Cookies tab.  

### 2026-10-02 · Visualize Data in the SQL console

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592117454*

You can now use the Visualize Data by selecting the  (Visualize Data) icon in the Result toolbar to view statement results as charts and graphs in the SQL Console.  

### 2026-10-02 · View service managed HDI containers

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077132*

In the Schemas & HDI Containers app, you can now:  
- View HDI containers managed using SAP Service Manager instances in your Cloud Foundry spaces separately.  
- Open a service managed HDI container directly in the SQL console.  
See [Using Schemas & HDI Containers in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/caf464055fc9424c98257d57c93a0d08).  

### 2026-10-02 · Preview image files in SQL Console

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077135*

You can now see a preview of image files in SQL Console.  

### 2026-10-02 · Move Database Tenants Across Subaccounts

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077128*

In SAP HANA Cloud Central, you can now move tenants to instances in other BTP subaccounts within the same region. The Target Database Instance field in the Move Tenant dialog lists both instances in the current subaccount and instances from other subaccounts that have been shared with the current subaccount via an instance mapping.  

### 2026-10-02 · Manage Statement Hints

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077127*

You can now view, add, enable, disable, and remove SQL statement hints in the SQL Statements app.  
See:  
- [Monitoring SQL Statements in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/4d5dca0665f54dc9aed8d0c53171bbd4.html)  
- [Manage Statement Hints](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/67265f42f0ce4d1c971680983c1fa33f.html)  

### 2026-10-02 · Improved cube metadata display in Database Objects

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077149*

New columns have been added to the Attributes, Hierarchies, Variables, and Measures tabs to display additional cube properties in Database Objects.  

### 2026-10-02 · Consolidated Trends View in the SQL Statements App

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077133*

The Performance Heatmap and Statement Trend Chart tabs in the SQL Statement Overview are now combined into a single Trends tab, so you can view heatmap charts and statement trends without switching between tabs.  
See:  
- [Monitor and Manage Active SQL Statements](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/09bbf686d8974ff58b82ecc5d7e5ccc5.html)  
- [Monitor and Manage Cached SQL Statements](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/544449d376634e81b27b6e958498e0df.html)  
- [Trace and Manage Expensive SQL Statements](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/e6dcc3023ef449d9a10a042e54bc01bc.html)

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592077117*

You can now partition tables using two new three-level heterogeneous schemes: HASH-RANGE-RANGE and HASH-HASH-RANGE.  
See [Three-Level HASH-RANGE-RANGE and HASH-HASH-RANGE Partitioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/1904e0a4edbf465c9b131ae53cf25972.html).  

### 2026-09-28 · SAP HANA Cloud Agent Memory Service

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Other · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 593344769*

SAP HANA Cloud now offers Agent Memory Service, a service plan (hana-agent-memory) that gives AI agents persistent memory. Provisioned on SAP BTP through SAP HANA Cloud, it stores durable, semantically searchable memories and chronological messages, associated with an agent and invoker, through a standard OData REST API with OAuth 2.0 authentication.  
See [SAP HANA Cloud Agent Memory Service Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-agent-memory-service-guide/).  

### 2026-09-23 · HANA Cloud available in Sovereign Cloud

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Administration · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 593344768*

SAP HANA Cloud is available in the following SAP sovereign cloud landscapes: Australia (AWS), Canada (AWS), United Kingdom (AWS), USA (AWS GovCloud), India (AWS), and Europe (SAP Cloud Infrastructure). For more information, see [Data Center Availability in SAP HANA Cloud](6c104f33f16e48579ee52858c13a9405.html) and [Memory and Storage Sizes Supported by SAP HANA Database](798c2c6ba7ae41e898f423aa34491ac3.html).

### 2026-09-21 · Virtual table support for Apache Iceberg format version 3

You can now create virtual tables for read-only access to Apache Iceberg format v3 tables.  
- Apache Iceberg format v3 deletion vectors are supported.  
- Other features specific to Iceberg format v3, such as variant, geometry, geography, nanosecond-precision timestamps, column default values, and row-level lineage are not supported.

You can now include calculation views alongside tables, views, and functions in the Data Exploration Tools to answer natural language questions based on your data.  
See [Managing Data Exploration Tools in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/ceb43558ceae4f85b51df0c2a8a5478c.html).

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Smart Data Access · Version: 2026.28 (QRC 3/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248091*

You can now use the toggling feature to perform real-time replication of CDS views from remote ABAP systems (SAP S/4HANA and SAP S/4HANA Cloud).  
See [Toggling Between Virtual Tables and Replica Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/toggling-between-virtual-tables-and-replica-tables).  

### 2026-09-21 · Time series foundation model support in PAL AutoML

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2026.28 (QRC 3/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248071*

Time series foundation model (TSFM) is a built-in time series pipeline operator that produces zero-shot forecasts. You can use it for univariate forecasting on tabular series with optional past and future covariates. No per-dataset model training is required.  
See [TSFM](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/tsfm).  

### 2026-09-21 · Three-Level Partitioning for Tables

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Partitioning · Version: 2026.28 (QRC 3/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry, Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595244591*

You can now create three-level partitioned tables using HASH-RANGE-RANGE and HASH-HASH-RANGE structures in SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database. Three-level partitioning extends the existing two-level partitioning support. The third level is always range partitioning. For HASH-HASH-RANGE structures, enabling a third level also allows the number of second-level hash partitions to differ across first-level partitions, which is not possible in standard two-level HASH-HASH structures.  
See [Partitioning Tables Using SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/1904e0a4edbf465c9b131ae53cf25972.html).  

### 2026-09-21 · Theil-Sen regression

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2026.28 (QRC 3/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248070*

PAL now supports Robust Linear (Theil-Sen) regression. For multiple linear regression, you can use Theil-Sen regression as a robust method to estimate a full coefficient vector and intercept. You can train Theil-Sen regression on a dataset that includes some percentage of outlier or contaminated data. The method generates a model that largely ignores these outliers.  
See [Robust Linear Regression](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/robust-linear-regression).  

### 2026-09-21 · Support of spatial columns in NSE Advisor

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Spatial · Version: 2026.28 (QRC 3/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry, Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595244590*

The NSE advisor now supports spatial data. You can get recommendations on the load unit of your spatial columns, and tables or partitions with spatial columns, according to how frequently they are accessed.  
See [Spatial Columns in SAP HANA's Native Storage Extension](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/4aba163f8928439ba69024c430a9a606.html).  

### 2026-09-21 · Support for small 16GB database instances

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Administration · Version: 2026.28 (QRC 3/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry, Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595244589*

You can now provision database instances with 16GB memory for Microsoft Azure regions. Use this option for cost-sensitive workloads that don't require larger instance sizes.  
See [Managing Smaller SAP HANA Instances](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/9bce6654977c4dd6ac98f885f15835f5.html).

SAP HANA Cloud now supports specifying multiple issuer distinguished names (DNs) in a single X.509 provider. Issuer DNs can be added or removed on demand to accommodate sub-CA rotations without creating parallel providers.  
See [X.509 Certificate-Based User Authentication](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/2b335f7eec6a450095f110ea961d77cc.html).

You can now use the SIMPLE HDI API to grant and revoke privileges in SAP HANA Deployment Infrastructure (HDI) with simplified procedures. The API provides a streamlined alternative to the standard HDI privilege management procedures at three levels: DI, container group, and container.  
See [SIMPLE HDI API Reference](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/c95e5bdf13a34446bcf3b6c2f955adf5.html).

When creating Data Exploration Tools, you can now select the AI model to use for the tool pair. Available models are GPT-4.1 (default) and Claude 4.6 Sonnet.  
See [Managing Data Exploration Tools in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/ceb43558ceae4f85b51df0c2a8a5478c.html).  

### 2026-09-21 · SUBSTRING Partitioning for NVARCHAR Columns

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Partitioning · Version: 2026.28 (QRC 3/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry, Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595244592*

You can now use the SUBSTRING function as a partition expression to partition tables on a fixed segment of an NVARCHAR column value. Date and time partition expressions such as YEAR(), MONTH(), and HOUR() apply only to date and time columns. For NVARCHAR columns that follow a structured format, you can now use SUBSTRING to achieve equivalent partitioning behavior. For example, you can partition a table by the year segment of an SAP S/4HANA fiscal year period column.  
See [Partitioning Using the SUBSTRING Function](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/d318d56f2052402f9722b332a1f2943d.html).

When you perform remote table replication, fuzzy search indexes created on SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database QRC3/2026 or higher are now included in the replication.  
- Fuzzy search indexes created on SAP HANA on-premise systems or SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database QRC2/2026 or lower are not replicated.

### 2026-09-21 · Recreate Data Access Agents after Multi-Region Failover

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Smart Data Access · Version: 2026.28 (QRC 3/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry, Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248095*

In a multi-region disaster recovery setup, after failover, you can restore connectivity to remote sources and virtual tables in the former secondary region instance. To do this, create Data Access Agents using the same names and adapters as the original Data Access Agents in the primary region instance.  
See:  
- [Remote Source Connections After Multi-Region Failover](450c61e46499425894ef30e6e648e179.html)  
- [Recreate Data Access Agent After Multi-Region Failover](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/90e3c5e8382540e3aff9c5208fecb5ab)  

### 2026-09-21 · Near-zero downtime operations on primary source instance

In a multi-region disaster recovery setup, you can upgrade and apply configuration changes without a restart only on the primary region source instance.  
See [Multi-Region Disaster Recovery](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/14c2ffe2d13542fc894383a8536177b4.html).  

### 2026-09-21 · Native Multitenancy Support in Multi-Region Disaster Recovery

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Multitenancy · Version: 2026.28 (QRC 3/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry, Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248065*

Protect database tenants of your SAP HANA database instance by replicating them to a secondary replica instance in another region. This enables system failover in the event of a regional disaster. See [Multi-Region Disaster Recovery with SAP HANA Cloud Multitenancy](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/dd8c24eab8014a96a9120a37eaf750ff.html).

Imputer mode extends PAL_MLP_MULTI_TASK with the ability to train a network that can impute (predict) missing categorical values in a dataset. To activate this mode, declare one or more OVERLAPPED_VARIABLE parameters.

### 2026-09-21 · GeoSPARQL Support

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Knowledge Graph · Version: 2026.28 (QRC 3/2026) · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248384*

The SAP HANA Cloud knowledge graph engine implements GeoSPARQL 1.1. GeoSPARQL is an Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) standard that defines how to represent and query geospatial information in RDF graphs using SPARQL. It provides a standardized approach for working with location-based data in knowledge graphs. See [GeoSPARQL Support](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-knowledge-graph-guide/geosparql-support) and [GeoSPARQL Functions](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sparql-reference-guide/geosparql-functions).

### 2026-09-21 · FIPS-Compliant Certificate Fingerprint Algorithm

*Area: Security · Action: Required · Type: Changed (Incompatible) · Category: Encryption · Version: 2026.28 (QRC 3/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry, Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248090*

SAP HANA Cloud now supports SHA-256 for the fingerprint value shown in the FINGERPRINT column of the CERTIFICATES and ROOT_CERTIFICATES views, as well as in the PARSE_CERTIFICATES function. The hashing algorithm is controlled by the new certificate_fingerprint_algorithm parameter, which accepts the values md5 and sha256. The default remains md5 and will change to sha256 in QRC4/2026. After a transition period, the parameter will be removed and the FINGERPRINT column will always display the SHA-256 value.  
See:  
- [SAP Note 3803891 - Incompatible Change - Algorithm MD5 is replaced by SHA256 for column FINGERPRINT in the views CERTIFICATES, ROOT_CERTIFICATES and in the function PARSE_CERTIFICATES](https://me.sap.com/notes/3803891)  
- [Certificate Management](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/1e6042c4402545f7a0574f7bc91fab25.html)  
- [SQL Statements and Authorization for Certificate Management (Reference)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/f32bcc9c4b734f24bedaf6253e7981d6.html)

### 2026-06-22 · Specify metadata version for file-based Iceberg table remote sources

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SQL on Files · Version: 2026.14 (QRC 2/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248097*

You can now explicitly specify the metadata version to use for virtual tables on file-based Iceberg tables. A new virtual table property metadata_file_name allows you to specify a file containing the version metadata. Additionally, you can use the new GET_ICEBERG_METADATA_FILES built-in function to discover available metadata files for your file-based Iceberg remote source.  
The file adapter selects the metadata file to use in the following order:  
- The metadata file you specify in the new metadata_file_name​ virtual table property  
- A version-hint.txt​ file in the metadata directory that contains the version number  
- The metadata file with the highest version number  
See:  
- [Create a Virtual Table](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/replicating-cds-views-from-remote-abap-sources)

*Area: Administration · Action: Required · Type: Changed (Incompatible) · Category: Other · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 593344773*

### 2026-03-23 · New dimensionality reduction method: Feature Agglomeration

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2026.2 (QRC 1/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248081*

Feature Agglomeration is a new dimensionality reduction method in PAL. It merges related features into composite groups based on pairwise similarities like correlation or distance. This method improves computational efficiency and model interpretability by reducing dataset dimensionality while preserving the most informative aspects of your original data.  
See [Feature Agglomeration](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/feature-agglomeration).

### 2026-03-23 · M_SQL_PLAN_CACHE system view

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: SQL · Version: 2026.2 (QRC 1/2026) · Environment: Cloud Foundry, Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248121*

The LAST_INVALIDATION_REASON column now includes more detailed invalidation reasons for several cases when HEX plans are recompiled:  
- Table size exceeds a predefined threshold  
- Column dictionary is not sorted in binary order  
- A required index was dropped  
- No vector index exists  
Other invalidation reasons are caused by new records that break plan assumptions:  
- Value order ID order not preserved  
- Unexpected NULL values  
- Column min/max values have changed  
- Maximum partition value ID exceeded  
- Maximum value ID exceeded  
- Single-value constraint invalidated  
Previously, many cases appeared only with a catch-all WITHOUT-FALLBACK RECOMPILE reason provided.  
See [M_SQL_PLAN_CACHE System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20c57b8e75191014b22fcc8222b15970).

### 2025-12-22 · Unified time series interfaces

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2025.40 (QRC 4/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248396*

Unified time series is a unified interface to access some time series algorithms with pivoted or unpivoted data format. It also offers massive interfaces for both data formats. The supported time series algorithms are:  
- Additive Model Time Series Analysis (AMTSA)  
- Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA)  
- Bayesian Structural Time Series (BSTS)  
- Exponential Smoothing (SMOOTH)  
The unified time series include the following interfaces:  
- [Unified Time Series](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/unified-time-series?version=2025_4_QRC)  
- [Unified Time Series with Pivoted Input Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/no-content-for-file-unified-time-series-with-pivoted-input-data-md?version=2025_4_QRC)  
- [Unified Massive Time Series](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/no-content-for-file-unified-massive-time-series-md?version=2025_4_QRC)  
- [Unified Massive Time Series with Pivoted Input Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/no-content-for-file-unified-massive-time-series-with-pivoted-input-data-md?version=2025_4_QRC)

### 2025-12-22 · Cross Encoder API (NLP service)

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2025.40 (QRC 4/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248398*

A cross encoder is a neural network model that processes two inputs, like a query and a document, together to find their relationship or similarity. It outputs a relevance score. Unlike bi-encoders, which encode inputs separately into vectors, cross encoders analyze the interaction between the input pair at the same time. This allows for clear semantic understanding and accurate results, especially in re-ranking tasks within information retrieval. This quarter, you will be able to use the API interface for the Cross Encoder function. The model is available in the SAP HANA NLP service.  
See:  
- [Cross Encoder](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/cross-encoder?version=2025_4_QRC)  
- [Cross Encoder Model](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/cross-encoder-model?version=2025_4_QRC)

### 2025-09-22 · Virtual table support for Apache Iceberg tables

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SQL on Files · Version: 2025.28 (QRC 3/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248492*

You can now create virtual tables to Apache Iceberg tables on SQL on Files remote sources using the file adapter. Additionally, time travel queries are supported on remote Iceberg tables, and the built-in functions GET_ICEBERG_SNAPSHOTS and GET_VIRTUAL_TABLE_FILES_PARTITIONS allow you to retrieve information about Iceberg snapshots and their partitions.  
See:  
- [Create a Virtual Table](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/create-virtual-table)  
- [Time Travel Queries on Iceberg Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/time-travel-queries-on-iceberg-tables)  
- [GET_ICEBERG_TABLE_SNAPSHOTS Function](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/get-iceberg-table-snapshots)  
- [GET_VIRTUAL_TABLE_FILE_PARTITIONS Function](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/get-virtual-table-file-partitions)  

### 2025-09-22 · Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP)

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2025.28 (QRC 3/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248405*

Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) is a non-linear dimension reduction method. You can use it for visualization and as pre-processing for other algorithms, such as clustering. The new procedure _SYS_AFL.PAL_UMAP has been added.  
See [Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/uniform-manifold-approximation-and-projection)  

### 2025-09-22 · Threshold support in time series outlier detection

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2025.28 (QRC 3/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248409*

The time series outlier detection outputs an outlier threshold. If a data point exceeds this threshold, it is considered a potential outlier without needing to rerun the detection function. The parameter related to this change is OUTPUT_OUTLIER_THRESHOLD. Setting it to one enables the feature, but it introduces additional calculations.  
See [Outlier Detection](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/outlier-detection-outlier-detection-17253b4).  

### 2025-09-22 · Target encoding support in AutoML

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2025.28 (QRC 3/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248407*

PAL AutoML now offers new target encoding capabilities. The AutoML framework automatically analyzes dataset cardinality to decide whether to use target encoding or another encoding method. For features with higher cardinality, target encoding can significantly improve performance.  
See [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/automl-automl).  

### 2025-09-22 · TLS Hostname Validation for Secure Connections

*Area: Security · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Authentication · Version: 2025.28 (QRC 3/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry, Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248473*

Strict hostname validation behavior has been enabled for outgoing TLS connection. This ensures that connections are refused if hostname validation fails.  
The hostname validation behavior is configurable.  
[3656433](https://me.sap.com/notes/3656433)

### 2025-09-22 · New Partitioning Layouts: HASH–HASH–RANGE and HASH–RANGE–RANGE

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Partitioning · Version: 2025.28 (QRC 3/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry, Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248141*

SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database now supports multi-level partitioning with HASH–HASH–RANGE and HASH–RANGE–RANGE layouts. This enables more flexible partitioning strategies for large tables with mixed access patterns and NSE-optimized fields, improving both performance and memory efficiency.

It is now possible to configure X.509 identity providers for automatic user creation in conjunction with LDAP group authorization.  
This means that if you use an LDAP-compliant directory server to manage users and their access to resources, you can now leverage this infrastructure to provision the database users required for X.509-authenticated users.  
A database user can be automatically created for a X.509-authenticated user if the user exists in your LDAP server and this user is a member of at least one LDAP group mapped to at least one SAP HANA role.

### 2025-06-23 · Replica Table Initialization with ATR/OSTR

*Area: Smart Data Access · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Remote Source · Version: 2025.14 (QRC 2/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248493*

ATR/OSTR replica tables offer a more efficient method for initializing remote table replication (RTR) tables by utilizing local table copies, reducing dependency on network speed. This feature optimizes performance when frequently adding or removing RTR replica tables, especially in environments with Elastic Compute Nodes.  
See [Table Replication](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/33dd5d248add4b7a8c085846748b80ba.html), [Table Replication Limitations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/7683a6b0e9f649808cb956cd50087c5f.html).

### 2025-06-23 · New NLP model and infrastructure update

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2025.14 (QRC 2/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248417*

PAL introduces a new embedding model called SAP_GXY. Below are detailed updates regarding the models and infrastructure improvements:  
- The model supports eight languages, with three new languages—Chinese (ZH), Japanese (JP), and Italian (IT)—added compared to the first model, SAP_NEB.  
- This model improves accuracy in multiple languages.  
- This model enhances short text embedding capabilities.  
- This model increases the default maximum token limit to 512.  
- The NER model's accuracy and robustness are also improved.  
Note  
In QRC 2/2025, we switched the serving infrastructure from TensorFlow to PyTorch. This change may cause slight decimal differences in the embedded vector of the previous SAP_NEB model version 20240715. The overall impact on the STS and Q&A task results will be minor. If needed, you can re-embed the previous content to eliminate these differences. This is a one-time change.  
See [Text Embedding Model](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-embedding-model).

### 2025-06-23 · Machine learning lifecycle management

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2025.14 (QRC 2/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248410*

PAL introduces tracking and scheduling functions to help you manage machine learning experiments.  
- The track function logs parameters, dataset metadata, metrics, model signatures, and figure data to predefined tables when running PAL procedures. You can later reproduce, visualize results, or use derived models for inference and evaluation. The tracking-enabled interface provides additional log tables and APIs for you to trace and manage processes.  
- The scheduled execution function allows SQLScript procedures to run in scheduler jobs, focusing on PAL procedures. Unlike traditional synchronous execution, scheduled execution supports asynchronous, time-frequency-based processes.  
- The Python Machine Learning Client for SAP HANA includes additional client-side interfaces and a GUI.  
See:  
- [PAL Track](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/pal-track)  
- [Calling PAL with Schedule](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/calling-pal-with-schedule)

### 2025-06-23 · Constrained clustering

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2025.14 (QRC 2/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248411*

Constraints provide extra information to guide the clustering process, ensuring results align with specific requirements or prior knowledge. There are two types of constraints:  
- Pairwise constraints: Must-link constraints require two data points to be in the same cluster. Cannot-link constraints ensure two data points are not in the same cluster.  
- Triplet Constraints: With an anchor instance (a), a positive instance (p), and a negative instance (n), the constraint shows that instance a is more similar to p than to n.  
See [Constrained Clustering](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/constrained-clustering).

### 2025-03-24 · Introduction of SAP HANA Cloud knowledge graph engine

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Knowledge Graph · Version: 2025.2 (QRC 1/2025) · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248391*

The SAP HANA Cloud knowledge graph engine lets SAP HANA database users work with knowledge graphs. It's built on the W3C standards and guidelines for graph data, known as Resource Description Format (RDF). RDF contains triples in the format subject-predicate-object. The associated query language is SPARQL. Knowledge graphs are stored in SAP HANA Cloud knowledge graph engine's triple store.  
The SAP HANA Cloud knowledge graph engine is an integral part of SAP HANA Cloud. It is an addition to the SAP HANA Cloud multimodel engines.  
See:  
- [SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database Knowledge Graph Engine Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-knowledge-graph-guide/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-knowledge-graph-engine-guide)  
- [SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database SPARQL Reference Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/internal-sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sparql-reference-guide/internal-sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sparql-reference-guide)  
With QRC 1/2025, the SAP HANA Cloud Graph engine has been renamed to SAP HANA Cloud property graph engine. The reason for this change is the introduction of the SAP HANA Cloud knowledge graph engine. The name change makes it easier to distinguish between the two products.  
Starting with QRC 1/2025, the What's New category for the SAP HANA Cloud property graph engine is "Property Graph" and no longer "Graph".  
See [SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database Property Graph Engine Reference](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-property-graph-engine-reference/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-property-graph-engine-reference)

### 2025-03-24 · Enhancements to Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree (HGBT)

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2025.2 (QRC 1/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248418*

PAL introduced the following enhancements to HGBT:  
- Linear Tree Support: Introduced new parameters, MODEL_TREE and LINEAR_LAMBDA, to extend support for linear trees.  
- Multi-Target Support: Enhanced the DEPENDENT_VARIABLE parameter to enable multiple target regression when set to REAL_VECTOR or when multiple entities are present. Ensure all targets are continuous features.  
- Multiple Classification Enhancement: Implemented the USE_VEC_LEAF parameter to support vector leaf features in multiple classifications.  
See [Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/hybrid-gradient-boosting-tree-hybrid-gradient-boosting-tree-ca5106c).

### 2025-03-24 · Changed Behavior - Upcoming privilege change for CREATE OR REPLACE { TRIGGER | VIEW | SYNONYM } statements

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: Changed (Incompatible) · Version: 2025.2 (QRC 1/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · Software_Lifecycle: General Availability · SAP-ID 595248575*

Behavioral change of privileges required for CREATE OR REPLACE { TRIGGER | VIEW | SYNONYM } statements. Executing CREATE OR REPLACE { TRIGGER | VIEW | SYNONYM } statement requires a different set of specific object privileges on the schema where {TRIGGER | VIEW | SYNONYM} is created or replaced. See [3326021](https://me.sap.com/notes/3326021) for details.  

### 2025-03-24 · Changed Behavior - ORDER BY clause on LOB column in Aggregation Function

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: Changed (Incompatible) · Category: SQL · Version: 2025.2 (QRC 1/2025) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · Software_Lifecycle: General Availability · SAP-ID 595248576*

Applying the ORDER BY clause on an LOB column in an aggregation function (for example, STRING_AGG, FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, NTH_VALUE) as part of a SQL statement, generates an error message similar to the following:  
SAP DBTech JDBC: [264]: invalid datatype: "V" LOB type in ORDER BY clause of aggregation: line 1 col 32 (at pos 31)  
This behavior occurs regardless of whether the SQL statement is executed in the HEX engine or legacy engine.  
See SAP Note [3580825](https://me.sap.com/notes/3580825/E)for details.

### 2024-12-23 · Vector principal component (VPC) analysis

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.40 (QRC 4/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248427*

PCA is a tailored version of PCA for vector-based input and output data. In the realm of vector embedding applications, such as word embedding, document embedding, and image embedding, nearly all input and output data are vector-based. In the HANA Cloud database, the vector-based data type is supported by the SQL type REAL_VECTOR. With the procedures provided by this algorithm, you can reduce high-dimensional vector data to lower-dimensional vector data while accounting for as much of the variation in the original data as possible.  
See [Vector Principal Component Analysis](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/vector-principal-component-analysis).

### 2024-12-23 · Text embedding

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.40 (QRC 4/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248422*

Text embedding is the process of converting words into a numerical form that can be understood and utilized by machine learning algorithms. This method represents a word or a piece of text as a high-dimensional vector within a predefined space, where words or text with similar meanings are positioned closer to one another.  
See [Text Embedding](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-embedding).  

### 2024-12-23 · Text chunking

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.40 (QRC 4/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248425*

Text chunking, also known as shallow parsing, is a process in natural language processing (NLP) that groups words into chunks of information. These chunks usually consist of words that come together to form phrases. The following three major chunking methods are now supported: Character Splitting Character splitting is the simplest form of chunking, where the text is dissected into chunks of N-characters, completely oblivious of the content or structure of the text. Recursive Splitting The shortcoming of character splitting is its neglect of the organization of the document, as it indiscriminately splits based on a fixed character count. Document Splitting The objective of this splitting procedure is to modify the chunking strategy to suit different data formats or languages. The PlainText and HTML splitters are similar to recursive splitting, but they use different separators or are adapted to different languages.  
See [Text Chunking](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-chunking).  

### 2024-12-23 · Text analysis

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.40 (QRC 4/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248423*

The new text analysis service currently supports the following tasks: Named Entity Recognition (NER) NER, also known as named entity identification, entity chunking, or entity extraction, is a sub-task of information extraction. It seeks to locate and classify named entities mentioned in unstructured text into predefined categories such as person names, organizations, locations, medical codes, time expressions, quantities, monetary values, and percentages. Sentiment Analysis Sentiment Analysis assigns a sentiment score, which is a numerical representation of the sentiment or emotion conveyed in a piece of text, such as a tweet, product review, or article. It indicates whether the sentiment expressed is positive, negative, or neutral. This task outputs sentiment at the document, sentence, and word levels. Part of Speech (POS) Analysis POS analysis classifies words based on their role in a sentence. Examples of POS tags include nouns, verbs, and adjectives.  
See [Text Analysis](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-analysis-textanalysis).

### 2024-12-23 · New developer-license version of the SAP HANA Data Lake Client for Linux

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Development · Version: 2024.4.5103 (QRC 4/2024) · Environment: Other · Component: Data Lake · SAP-ID 548348168*

Users that don't have a full license can now install a developer-license version of the SAP HANA Data Lake Client for Linux. A Windows installation package is not yet available.  
The developer-license version does not contain cryptographic libraries and is available for download from [SAP Development Tools](https://tools.hana.ondemand.com/#hanatools). The installation allows you to perform development on the client without a full license.  
For more information, see [Download the SAP HANA Data Lake Client](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a895964984f210158925ce02750eb580/2fdb23a4fb364e06ace0eea0c9a4afec.html) and [Install the SAP HANA Data Lake Client (Developer License)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/client-interfaces/install-sap-hana-data-lake-client-developer-license).  

### 2024-12-23 · New and modified BIMC views

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Analytics Catalog (BIMC Views) Reference · Version: 2024.40 (QRC 4/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · Software_Lifecycle: General Availability · SAP-ID 595248218*

New and modified BIMC views:  
- BIMC_CUBES (BIMC_ALL_CUBES): New OBJECT_ORIGIN Column  
Determines the origin of the CUBES metadata, indicating whether it was deployed by HDI or created using a DDL statement.  
- BIMC_DIMENSIONS and BIMC_MEASURES: Filter on IS_HIDDEN Column  
Filters based on the IS_HIDDEN column (not visible in the result set) to display only non-hidden attributes or measures in calculation views.  
- BIMC_DIMENSIONS_INCLUDE_HIDDEN and BIMC_MEASURES_INCLUDE_HIDDEN: New IS_HIDDEN Column  
Includes an IS_HIDDEN column that indicates whether a column associated with a dimension or measure is hidden.  
See:  
- [Table BIMC_ALL_CUBES](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-analytics-catalog-bimc-views-reference/table-bimc-all-cubes)  
- [Table BIMC_DIMENSIONS](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-analytics-catalog-bimc-views-reference/table-bimc-dimensions)  
- [View BIMC_MEASURES](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-analytics-catalog-bimc-views-reference/view-bimc-measures)  
- [View BIMC_DIMENSIONS_INCLUDE_HIDDEN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-analytics-catalog-bimc-views-reference/view-bimc-dimensions-include-hidden)  
- [View BIMC_MEASURES_INCLUDE_HIDDEN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-analytics-catalog-bimc-views-reference/view-bimc-dimension-view-include-hidden)

### 2024-12-23 · Enhanced multi-task multilayer perceptron (MLP)

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.40 (QRC 4/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248429*

Multi-task MLP has the following enhancements:  
- Supports state model prediction  
- Supports online training and fine-tuning  
- Supports categorical variables (integer type)  
- Replaces the MLP operator in AutoML  
- Supports vector type

### 2024-12-23 · Elastic Compute Node (General Availability)

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Performance · Version: 2024.40 (QRC 4/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248167*

The Elastic Compute Node (ECN) is now available making it possible to run temporary (computeserver) processing nodes in your database instance to handle peaks in workload. The ECN can be easily added and dropped when no longer required. It incurs additional costs while the computeserver is running but helps to optimize the total cost of running the SAP HANA Cloud service.  
See [SAP HANA Cloud Elastic Compute Node](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/93dc81da7ba5457fa60f30cdd858b4df.html)

Dynamic structured filters now support complex filters.  

### 2024-12-23 · Distance calculation for spherical round-Earth SRSs

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Spatial · Version: 2024.40 (QRC 4/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248525*

For spherical round-Earth spatial reference systems (SRSs), the distance methods ST_Distance, ST_HausdorffDistance, and ST_WithinDistance are supported for all geometries.  
For non-spherical round-Earth spatial reference systems (SRSs), the distance methods ST_Distance, ST_HausdorffDistance, and ST_WithinDistance are supported only for point-to-point calculations.  
See:  
- [ST_WithinDistance Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-distance-method)  
- [ST_HausdorffDistance Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-hausdorffdistance-method)  
- [ST_WithinDistance Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-withindistance-method)  
- [List of All Supported Methods](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/list-of-all-supported-methods)  

### 2024-12-23 · Direct file access to external object storage providers

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: SQL on Files · Version: 2024.40 (QRC 4/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248500*

In addition to data lake Files containers, you can now create remote sources to external object storage providers. SQL on Files remote sources are read only and let you access files with the following file formats: CSV, Parquet, and Delta tables.

### 2024-12-23 · Best matching 25 (BM25) search

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.40 (QRC 4/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248426*

A new full-text search method utilizes the BM25 ranking function to rerank the TF-IDF results. BM25 is part of the family of probabilistic information retrieval models and is an extension of the Binary Independence Model (BIM). BM25 is widely used due to its effectiveness and simplicity.  
See [BM25 Search](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/bm25-search).  

### 2024-12-23 · Backup Compression

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Backup and Recovery · Version: 2024.28 (QRC 3/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248162*

Starting with QRC 3/2024, data and log backups in SAP HANA database instances are automatically compressed.  
See [Backup and Recovery](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/89d71f01daca4ecaaa069d6a060167f5.html).  

### 2024-12-23 · Automatic calculation of the unload_threshold

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Performance · Version: 2024.40 (QRC 4/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248166*

The buffer cache can automatically calculate the unload_threshold value in regular intervals, based on the actual NSE data persistence size in the system.  
See [Adjusting the Buffer Cache Size](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/2436bae042054ec880ff5d1f436ef0a0.html)  

### 2024-12-23 · Approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.40 (QRC 4/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248424*

ANN search is a swift algorithm used to identify the nearest data points to a given input in large datasets. It approximates distances rather than calculating exact values, which saves time and computational resources, making it efficient for searching in high-dimensional spaces.  
See [ANN Search](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/ann-search).  

### 2024-12-23 · Aliases for Range Partitions

You can now assign permanent names to range partitions in heterogeneous partitioning schemas and use the name in SQL statements to identify the partition. This avoids the need to refer to logical partition ids which are not permanent.

### 2024-09-23 · Propagation of the business user context

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Smart Data Access · Version: 2024.28 (QRC 3/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248505*

For SAP HANA remote sources (hanaodbc adapter) and ABAP remote sources (abapodbc adapter), the JSON Web token (JWT) exchange flow with the SAP Identity Authentication Service is now supported for principal propagation. The business user identity that is propagated as a session credential is exchanged for a JWT that allows the remote system to process the query within the context of the business user.  
See [Personalizing Connections to Remote SAP HANA Databases and Remote ABAP Systems by Exchanging JSON Web Tokens](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/personalizing-connections-to-remote-sap-hana-databases-and-remote-abap-systems-by-exchanging-json-web-tokens).

### 2024-09-23 · LENGTH function is not supported for ST_GEOMETRY data type

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Spatial · Version: 2024.28 (QRC 3/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248527*

Starting with SAP HANA Cloud release QRC 3/2024, the LENGTH function throws an error when it is executed with the spatial data type ST_GEOMETRY as input parameter. Until SAP HANA Cloud release QRC 2/2024, the LENGTH function implicitly converted the spatial data type ST_GEOMETRY to a string type and returned the length of the string.  
See:  
- [LENGTH Function (String)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/length-function-string)  
- [Spatial Data Type Conversions](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/spatial-data-type-conversions)  
- [SAP Note 3489570 - Changed Behavior of the LENGTH Function](https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3489570)

### 2024-09-23 · HDBSCAN

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.28 (QRC 3/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248431*

Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) is a popular clustering algorithm. Hierarchical Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (HDBSCAN) is a novel algorithm that also uses the idea of density but in a hierarchical way.  
See [HDBSCAN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/hdbscan).

The Multi-target MLP now includes the following enhanced features:

### 2024-06-24 · Variant Plans

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: SQL Plan Cache · Version: 2024.14 (QRC 2/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248181*

SQL Plan Cache has been enhanced to save SQL plan variants for parameterized queries. A variant is saved for each parameter set which has been used for the query. The feature can be enabled generally or applied to individual queries by appending a hint to the SQL statement.  
See [SQL Plan Cache for Parameterized Queries](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/ac43f5c3114a4798913582669094e4af.html).

### 2024-06-24 · Text classification

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.14 (QRC 2/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248436*

PAL introduces an enhancement version of the text classification algorithm.  
The new text classification algorithm uses RDT as the classifier instead of the old KNN classifier. The accuracy of text classification is also improved. The following two procedures are now added to the PAL library:  
- _SYS_AFL.PAL_TEXTCLASSIFICATION_TRAIN  
- _SYS_AFL.PAL_TEXTCLASSIFICATION_PREDICT  
See [Text Classification with Model (Train)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-classification-train) and [Text Classification with Model (Predict)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-classification-predict).

### 2024-06-24 · Reserved SQL error codes for Unavailability Reason Service

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: SQL · Version: 2024.14 (QRC 2/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248186*

An unavailability microservice is integrated into SAP HANA Cloud clusters, this is invoked if a HANA instance is not available, the URS then returns an explanatory error message to the client, such as: instance stopped, key revoked, instance upgrading and so on. Message texts are related to a set of SQL error codes (ERR_URS* in the range 1888-1919) which are reserved exclusively for this purpose and are available for use by application developers.  
See [SQL Error Codes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20a78d3275191014b41bae7c4a46d835.html).

### 2024-06-24 · Heterogeneous create partition clauses and heterogeneous alter partition clauses

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: SQL · Version: 2024.14 (QRC 2/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · Software_Lifecycle: General Availability · SAP-ID 595248620*

- Range generation has been extended to include decreasing and bidirectional dynamic range generation. A new column was added to the TABLE_PARTITIONS view to display this information.  
- Dynamic range checking can now be set a the table level. A new column was added to the PARTITIONED_TABLES view to display this information.  
- The <set_movable> property allows you to control whether a partition is movable. A new column was added to the TABLE_PARTITIONS and M_TABLE_PARTITIONS views to display this information.  
- Table partitions now support dynamic aging. A new column was added to the TABLE_PARTITIONS view to display this information.  
See:  
- [Heterogeneous Create Partition Clauses](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/heterogeneous-create-partition-clauses)

- [PARTITIONED_TABLES System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/partitioned-tables-system-view)

### 2024-06-24 · Dynamic Range Partitioning

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Partitioning · Version: 2024.14 (QRC 2/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248180*

Two enhancements have now been applied in the area of Dynamic Range Partitioning:  
- Background scan job: The frequency of the background job (the time interval at which dynamic range tables are scanned) can now be set differently for individual tables using the table property DYNAMIC RANGE CHECK INTERVAL.  
- Bidirectional growth for negative number ranges: A limitation related to partition ranges which are used to store negative values has been removed. These partitions can now accept values in both numerical directions (that is values which are at both the lower and higher ends of the range). The partitioning SQL syntax has been extended to support this.  
See [Dynamic Range Partitioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/6ebea7782b9e4758baeed923e388ee32.html).

### 2024-04-08 · Delete instances during status change

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592117634*

You can now delete an instance in SAP HANA Cloud Central if it's in one of these statuses: "Starting", "Stopping", "Upgrading", "Applying Changes", "Recovering", "Recreating", "Taking Over", "Upgrading to Paid Tier", and "Upgrading to Test and Development". This allows you to force-delete an instance if it hangs during start, or during another status change.  
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).

### 2024-03-25 · Permutation feature importance support for unified regression

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248446*

Permutation feature importance is a feature evaluation method that measures the decrease in the model score when PAL randomly shuffles the feature's values. It reveals how much the model relies on the feature for prediction by breaking the association between the feature and the true outcome. Support of unified regression is added this quarter.  
See [Permutation Importance](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/permutation-importance-permutation-importance-regression) for unified regression and [Permutation Importance](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/permutation-importance-permutation-importance-regression-pivoted) for unified regression with pivoted data.

### 2024-03-25 · New and modified BIMC views

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Analytics Catalog (BIMC Views) Reference · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · Software_Lifecycle: General Availability · SAP-ID 595248220*

New Views:  
- BIMC_DIMENSION_VIEW_INCLUDE_HIDDEN: Adds an IS_HIDDEN column to identify hidden status of dimension columns, simplifying the management of hidden columns.

### 2024-03-25 · New algorithm Hull White model

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248441*

The Hull-White model is a single-factor interest rate model that plays a crucial role in financial mathematics and risk management. The Hull-White model is particularly significant because it provides a framework for understanding how interest rates evolve over time, which is vital for pricing various financial instruments like bonds and interest rate derivatives.  
See [Hull-White](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/hull-white).  

### 2024-03-25 · New algorithm Benford Analysis

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248442*

Benford's Law, also known as the first-digit law, is a statistical technique used to detect anomalies or irregularities in numerical data sets.  
See [Benford Analysis](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/benford-analysis).

### 2024-03-25 · Enhancements to HGBT

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248444*

- Added a new objective function reweighted square for HGBT regression through the new parameter value 10 of the OBJ_FUNC parameter in the PAL_HGBT method.  
- New parameter VALIDATION_SET_METRIC to specify the metric for early stop of HGBT.  
- Added new values into the parameter EVALUATION_METRIC for cross validation:  
- F1_SCORE  
- RECALL  
- PRECISION  
- New parameters SCALE_WEIGHT and SCALE_WEIGHT_TARGET are added to the scale instance weight with specified labels.  
See [Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/hybrid-gradient-boosting-tree-hybrid-gradient-boosting-tree-ca5106c).  

### 2024-03-25 · Enhancements to AutoML

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248439*

- New FINETUNE_BESTPIPELINE function allows you to do continuous update on the selected best pipeline model.  
- Random search is now supported in the SEARCH_METHOD parameter to support rarely small configurations.  
- AutoML log now supports deletion with the new added procedure: PAL_REMOVE_AUTOML_LOG.  
See [Optimization](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/optimization-optimization) and [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/automl-automl).  

### 2024-03-25 · Discontinued Support for Select Cipher Suites

*Area: Security · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Encryption · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248488*

The following cipher suites for the TLS 1.2 protocol are no longer supported due to their non-compliance with SGS standards:  
- TLS_RSA_WITH_AES128_GCM_SHA256  
- TLS_RSA_WITH_AES256_GCM_SHA384  
If you are using an unsupported system, refer to the SAP Note to verify if you are affected and for possible solutions.  
See:  
[3446927](https://me.sap.com/notes/3446927)  
[Secure Communication Between SAP HANA and SAP HANA Clients](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/dbd3d887bb571014bf05ca887f897b99.html)  

### 2024-03-25 · Concise auditing

*Area: Security · Action: Info only · Type: Changed (Incompatible) · Category: Auditing · Version: 2024.1.4051 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Other · Component: Data Lake · SAP-ID 548348182*

Concise auditing streamlines and simplifies data lake Relational Engine auditing. This is a breaking change in auditing behavior. You can either set the new CONCISE_AUDITING database option to 'Off' before you upgrade to QRC 1/2024 (with no disruption to auditing) or do nothing and let data lake switch to new concise auditing behavior during the QRC 1/2024 upgrade.  
See:  
- [SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Auditing Migration Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/86c0211675e14d6389471ba4f4f2c83e/38778500666d4887af5190d6bf233d63.html)  
- [CONCISE_AUDITING Option for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/742c50f6746f4fb488ed6498e203def4.html)  
- [CONCISE_AUDITING Option for Data Lake Relational Engine (SAP HANA DB-Managed)](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a898e08b84f21015969fa437e89860c8/e47cf784a3274b41bbaaa416bcc07d97.html)

In the calculation view editor in the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, when you add or delete input parameters in a calculation view, you can now propagate these changes recursively to dependent views.

In the calculation view editor in the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now flexibly define how column names should be made unique when mapping columns in join nodes.  
See [Define Output Columns](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/define-output-columns).  

### 2024-03-25 · Calculation Views

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: SAP HANA Development Tooling · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248332*

In the calculation view editor in the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you now have the option to block queries on a deprecated calculation view.

### 2024-03-25 · Calculation Views

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Development Tooling · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248333*

In the calculation view editor in the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now open a calculation view in read-only mode by right-clicking it and choosing Open With…    Calculation View Editor (Read Only).  
See [Opening Calculation Views in Read-Only Mode](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/opening-calculation-views-in-read-only-mode).  

### 2024-03-25 · Calculation Views

*Area: Development · Action: Recommended · Type: Changed (Incompatible) · Category: SAP HANA Development Tooling · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248334*

The handling of NULL values in rank nodes has been aligned with the NULL handling behavior of window function nodes. This means that NULL values are now considered valid values, which is the standard behavior of window function nodes.  
Action: To retain the former behavior, a projection node with an IS NOT NULL filter can be added as an input node for the rank node.  
See SAP Note [3419990](https://me.sap.com/notes/3419990).  

### 2024-03-25 · Cache Management

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Cache Management · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248189*

Fine-grained control of the maximum size of individual caches is now supported by configuring (in the SYSTEM database) a maximum limit for each cache.  
See [Limit Cache Memory Usage](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/12c493156a194b71acd7fc2f6d20559b.html).

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: SQL · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · Software_Lifecycle: General Availability · SAP-ID 595248635*

The ASYNC keyword has been added to the CALL statement. The keyword creates a ASYNC_CALL_ID, which lets you cancel a specific procedure running in the background and view information about the procedure associated with the ID.See:
