### 2024-03-25 · Auto Recompilation

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SQL Plan Cache · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248192*

SQL Plan Cache can now detect the poor performance of a query and then on the basis of this assessment remove the query plan entry from the cache so that recompilation is triggered.  
See [SQL Plan Cache, Auto Recompilation](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/f0aaab730a1540758a8f36c9aee2118a.html).  

### 2024-03-25 · An enhancement to KNN

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248448*

New parameter value 2: Matrix enabled searching is added to the METHOD parameter of PAL_KNN and PAL_KNN_CV procedures. The new matrix-enabled searching performs faster but it only works when DISTANCE_LEVEL is set to 2 and the STRING_VARIABLE parameter is specified.  
See [KNN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/knn-knn-f2440c6).  

### 2024-03-25 · An enhancement to Fair ML

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248443*

New parameter FAIR_EXCLUDE_SENSITIVE_VARIABLE is added to the PAL_FAIRML function to decide whether or not to exclude sensitive variables in the training process. By default the sensitive variables are excluded.  
See [Fair ML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/fair-ml).  

### 2024-03-25 · Alert selection and filtering behavior

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Alerts and Notifications · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248194*

Changes have been made in the way alerts are filtered and displayed on screen in SAP HANA Cloud Central. Only the most severe occurrence of an alert is displayed. If you apply a filter to show only CURRENT alerts then time range filter values are not applied and all active alerts are displayed.  
See [Alerts](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/b8cc733919ff40eb8725ef47316c840b.html).  

### 2024-03-25 · Alert notifications for potential <samp class="ph codeph">TIMESTAMP</samp> data type conflicts

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SQL · Version: 2024.1.4051 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Other · Component: Data Lake · SAP-ID 548348181*

The SAP Alert Notification service now provides an alert when a possible conflict between the SAP HANA database and date lake Relational Engine TIMESTAMP data type is detected. Also, data lake Relational Engine now prevents the loading of 7-digits of precision TIMESTAMP values into a 6-digits column during an INSERT, UPDATE, or CAST.  

### 2024-03-25 · ABAP cloud and ABAP on-premise remote sources

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Smart Data Access · Version: 2024.02 (QRC 1/2024) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248514*

You can now create a remote source to the ABAP SQL service of an ABAP cloud system or on-premise ABAP system, using the SAP HANA smart data access abapodbc adapter. An ABAP cloud or on-premise remote source is read only and lets you access ABAP CDS view entities and parameterized ABAP CDS view entities in the remote ABAP system.  
Along with the support for ABAP remote sources, you can now create virtual parameterized views that point to remote parameterized ABAP CDS view entities in a remote ABAP system.  
See:  
- [Create an ABAP Cloud Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/create-abap-cloud-remote-source)  
- [Create an ABAP On-Premise Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/create-abap-on-premise-remote-source)  
- [Virtualizing Parameterized Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/virtualizing-parameterized-sql-views)

### 2024-03-18 · Table Load Monitor

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592117640*

You can now use the application Table Load Monitor in SAP HANA Cloud Central to review paging information (in-memory, in buffer cache, unloaded) of all partitions and columns for partitioned and non-partitioned tables. Note  
This feature is part of a larger initiative to integrate administration and monitoring tooling into a unified SAP HANA Cloud Central.  
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. *Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592117638*

*Area: Security · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Cloud Central · Version: Version independent · Environment: Other · Component: SAP HANA Cloud · SAP-ID 592117637*

You can now enable SAML-based single sign-on using SAML metadata. Use the assistant Guided Provider Creation in the SAML application to complete the following actions:

### 2023-12-07 · Permutation Feature importance support in time series functions

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.40 (QRC 4/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248653*

Permutation feature importance is a feature evaluation method that measures the decrease in the model score when we randomly shuffle the feature's values. It reveals how much the model relies on the feature for prediction by breaking the association between the feature and the true outcome.  
The following algorithms are supported from this release:  
- [ARIMA](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/arima-arima-dbd52a1)  
- [Unified Exponential Smoothing](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/unified-exponential-smoothing-unified-exponential-smoothing-0d3683e) (including all sub-functions)  
- [Bayesian Structural Time Series](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/bayesian-structural-time-series-bayesian-structural-time-series-b997257)  
- [Additive Model Time Series Analysis](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/additive-model-time-series-analysis-additive-model-time-series-analysis-7e78d06)  

### 2023-12-07 · New recommender system function MLPRecommender

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.40 (QRC 4/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248652*

This function uses neural network to predict binary targets such as click through rates, a fundamental part in recommender systems. Older methods such as ALS and FRM need specific user and item details, and they might not deal well with extra data features. As today's data grows in size and complexity, there are times when we only have unrelated features without any user connection. To work well with this large-scale, complicated data, MLP recommender is designed to boost the prediction performance.  
See [MLP Recommender](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/mlp-recommender).  

### 2023-12-07 · New algorithm fair ML

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.40 (QRC 4/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248651*

Fair ML aims at mitigating unfairness of prediction model due to some possible "bias" within data set regarding features such as sex, race, age and so on. It is a framework that can utilize other machine learning models or technologies which makes it quite flexible.  
For this release, it only supports HGBT model with binary classification and regression capabilities.  
See [Fair ML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/fair-ml).

### 2023-12-07 · Enhancements to automatic time series outlier detection

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.40 (QRC 4/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248654*

This algorithm has the following enhancements:

### 2023-12-07 · Enhancements to Pipeline

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.40 (QRC 4/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248650*

The pipeline algorithm has the following enhancements:

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Development Tooling · Version: 2023.40 (QRC 4/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248722*

In the calculation view editor in the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use a Refresh button to reload the data sources in an already opened calculation view. See [Refreshing Data Sources](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/refreshing-data-sources).

### 2023-11-17 · Root Certificate Replacement

*Area: Security · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Encryption · Version: 2023.28 (QRC 3/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248910*

SAP is changing the root certificate authority (CA) that is used to sign its transport layer security (TLS) connections to HANA Cloud servers from "DigiCert Global Root CA" to "DigiCert Global Root G2". [3399573](https://me.sap.com/notes/3399573)

### 2023-09-21 · Top N verbose classes in classification methods

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.28 (QRC 3/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248660*

Originally when the VERBOSE parameter is set for the classification predict method, all relevant classes and confidences for the prediction record are printed into the result table which may cause some performance issues. Now a new parameter VERBOSE_TOP_N is added for the prediction method of the following functions to control the number of output classes.  
- Decision trees  
- Hybrid gradient boosting tree  
- Multi-class logistic regression  
- Naïve Bayes  
- Random decision trees  
- Linear Discriminant Analysis  
- Unified classification  
- Unified Classification with Pivoted Input Data  
See [Verbose TopN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/verbose-topn-unpivot.html) for unified classification and [Verbose TopN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/verbose-topn-pivoted.html) for unified classification with pivoted input data.

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Workload Management · Version: 2023.28 (QRC 3/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry, Other · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248943*

### 2023-09-21 · STL decomposition method for seasonality test

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.28 (QRC 3/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248661*

A new time series decomposition method seasonal-trend decomposition using LOESS (STL) is added to seasonality test by the introduction of the new parameter DECOMPOSE_METHOD. SMOOTH_METHOD_NON_SEASONAL decomposition is enriched now with STL_ROBUST and STL_SEASONAL_AVERAGE as parameter values.  
By using STL decomposition, the trend component and seasonal component are obtained from multiple steps of LOESS and moving average. The random component can be estimated straightforwardly. If there is 0 or negative value in the time series, STL can only do additive decomposition.  
See [Seasonality Test](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/seasonality-test-d990dc7.html).

### 2023-09-21 · One-hot encoding enhancement

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.28 (QRC 3/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248657*

Using one-hot encoding on a feature with high cardinality may impact algorithm performance and memory consumption. To address this, two new parameters are introduced for algorithms that support embedded one-hot encoding for categorical features.  
- ONEHOT_MIN_FREQUENCY: Defines a minimal frequency for a category. If a category is lower than this parameter, it will be grouped with other low frequency categories.  
- ONEHOT_MAX_CATEGORIES: Defines a maximum category number for a feature. If the total categories exceeds this limit, the lowest categories will be grouped.  
Affected algorithms include:  
- Multi-Class Logistic Regression  
- Multilayer Perceptron  
- Support Vector Machine  
- Multiple Linear Regression  
- Spectral Clustering  
See [Multi-Class Logistic Regression](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multi-class-logistic-regression-bc5fe09.html), [Multilayer Perceptron](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multilayer-perceptron-ddd236d.html), [Support Vector Machine](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/support-vector-machine-901a10d.html), [Multiple Linear Regression](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multiple-linear-regression-eedc909.html), and [Spectral Clustering](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/spectral-clustering-d540a57.html).

### 2023-09-21 · New objective function and new boosting method support in HGBT

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.28 (QRC 3/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248659*

New objective function Huber Loss is added into HGBT. Also new majorized boosting method is added to enhance several existing objective functions like the pseudo Huber error objective function, making them more robust and efficient.  
Relative parameter HUBER_SLOPE is also added to the HGBT function for the Huber/Pseudo Huber objective function.  
The Huber loss statistic is similar to the mean absolute error (MAE), which is a type of loss function commonly used in regression problems. The Huber loss is a combination of the mean squared error (MSE) and the MAE, as it behaves like the MSE for small errors and like the MAE for large errors. It is less sensitive to outliers compared to the MSE, making it a popular choice when dealing with data that may contain extreme values or noise.  
See [Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/hybrid-gradient-boosting-tree-ca5106c.html).

### 2023-09-21 · Enhancements to text mining and TF-IDF

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.28 (QRC 3/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248663*

Added some parameters for text mining and TF-IDF, through which customers can have some control over the stopwords function.  
ENABLE_STOPWORDS: Specifies whether to enable the stopwords function. The following parameters will only take effect when this parameter is set to true. The default is true.  
KEEP_NUMERIC: Determines whether to keep numbers. The default is false.  
ALLOWED_LIST: A comma-separated list of words that will be retained by the stopwords logic.  
NOTALLOWED_LIST: A comma-separated list of words, which will be recognized and deleted by the stopwords logic.  
See [Term Analysis](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/term-analysis-0dd1876.html) and [TF-IDF Calculation](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/tf-idf-calculation-ef2bad0.html).

### 2023-06-22 · Table partition replication

*Area: Administration · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Smart Data Access · Version: 2023.16 (QRC 2/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248518*

Partition replication is now supported for remote sources based on the hanaodbc adapter. This means that you can replicate a selected subset of partitions from a source table in a remote SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database or SAP HANA on-premise system (SAP HANA 2.0 SPS 06 or higher) to a replica table in the SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database. For very large tables with multiple partitions, this can help to reduce the initial load.  
See [Replicate Partitions of a Table (Smart Data Access HANA Adapter)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/9620723585b3432e8e6341586388ffa4.html).

A hierarchical relationship of up to three levels of workload classes is now supported so that values for memory limits and thread limits can be inherited by other workload classes.

### 2023-06-22 · Permutation Feature importance support in unified classification

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.16 (QRC 2/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248665*

Permutation feature importance is a feature evaluation method that measures the decrease in the model score when we randomly shuffles the feature's values. It reveals how much the model relies on the feature for prediction by breaking the association between the feature and the true outcome.  
New unified classification will output all feature importance value in the VARIABLE_IMPORTANCE table for all the included algorithms by setting the following parameters:  
- PERMUTATION_IMPORTANCE: Whether to calculate permutation importance.  
- PERMUTATION_EVALUATION_METRIC: Specifies evaluation metric for model evaluation.  
- PERMUTATION_N_REPEATS: Specifies the number of times to permute a feature.  
- PERMUTATION_SEED: Specifies the seed for the random number generator.  
- PERMUTATION_N_SAMPLES: Specifies the number of samples to draw in each repeat.  
See [Permutation Importance](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/ff18019ef40846ffadb0604c9940a1c4.html) for unified classification and [Permutation Importance](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/e36d4e1759c34809b74f6ce4411709bc.html) for unified classification with pivoted input data.  

### 2023-06-22 · Outlier detection for time series enhancement

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.16 (QRC 2/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248668*

Outlier detection for time series now supports the new automatic selection of the detection algorithms and also two new algorithms are supported by enhancing and adding the following parameters:  
- AUTO: Whether to use the automatic detection method.  
- SMOOTH_METHOD:  
- 0: Median filter,  
- 1: LOESS (New)  
- 2: Super smoother  
Also it supports detection of intermittent time series by the following method:  
- DETECT_INTERMITTENT_TS: Whether to detect intermittent time series. The default value is 0. Only valid when using the automatic detection method.  
See [Outlier Detection](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/17253b432b324dd1afa0ef3074d4cd38.html).

### 2023-06-22 · Long-term time series forecasting

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.16 (QRC 2/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248664*

Long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) added three new linear based methods for speed and accuracy purpose. By introducing the new NETWORK_NAME parameter in the _SYS_AFL.PAL_LTSF_TRAIN method, now the following method types are supported:  
- 0 (Default) : NLinear, a network utilizing simple linear layers with normalization inside.  
- 1: DLinear, a network utilizing simple linear layers with trend and seasonal decomposition inside.  
- 2: XLinear, a network based on DLinear, incorporating exogenous data during prediction.  
- 3: SCINet, a network employing 1-dimensional convolution layers (Conv1d) and arranging them in a perfect binary tree architecture for interactive learning.  
See [Long-Term Series Forecasting](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/060735d9ed4f44f38c7b0b1ae094d98e.html).  

### 2023-06-22 · Interval quality measurement method

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.16 (QRC 2/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248666*

PAL has provided prediction interval and confidence interval output in several methods already. You can use this new method to measure the quality of those prediction intervals by considering the following aspects:  
- The interval width of significance level;  
- A penalty term for observations falling outside the lower or upper bound.  
See [Interval Quality](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/cf9e45d8369042dc9dbf51da2d39f7d4.html).

### 2023-06-22 · Changed Behavior of Aggregate Functions FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, and NTH_VALUE

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: Changed (Incompatible) · Category: Spatial · Version: 2023.16 (QRC 2/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248541*

Starting with the SAP HANA Cloud release QRC 2/2023, the functions FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, and NTH_VALUE return spatial types (ST_GEOMETRY, ST_POINT) when they are executed with spatial types (ST_GEOMETRY, ST_POINT) as input parameters.  
Until the SAP HANA Cloud release QRC 1/2023, the functions FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, and NTH_VALUE returned data type NVARCHAR when they were executed with spatial types (ST_GEOMETRY, ST_POINT) as input parameters.  
To keep the former behavior, use the CAST function (for example CAST(SHAPE AS NVARCHAR)).  
See:  
- [FIRST_VALUE Function (Aggregate)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/034b17549b5d4b7d913e2c2770eea45b.html)  
- [LAST_VALUE Function (Aggregate)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/32e95b7fac5c4b489d938c11ce5b4695.html)  
- [NTH_VALUE Function (Aggregate)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/6522df94eee542d5b1700a7766e6e6a2.html)  
- [SAP Note 3330849 - Changed Behavior of Aggregate Functions FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, and NTH_VALUE](https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3330849)  

### 2023-06-22 · Change of SRS and UOM Ownership

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: Changed (Incompatible) · Category: Spatial · Version: 2023.16 (QRC 2/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248542*

The ownership of spatial reference systems and spatial units of measure will be transferred from the user that created the objects to the database internal user SYS. All newly created spatial reference systems and units of measure will also be owned by the internal database user SYS.  
As a consequence, it will be possible to drop users that created referenced spatial reference systems and units of measure because they will no longer be the owners of those objects.  
See:  
- [CREATE SPATIAL REFERENCE SYSTEM &lt;srs-name&gt; Statement](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/604a9d60efd74d6892754b2b951e6e8d.html)  
- [CREATE PREDEFINED SPATIAL REFERENCE SYSTEM IDENTIFIED BY <srs-id> Statement](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/9ebcad604e8d4c43a802d08cfdbe8ab2.html)  
- [CREATE PREDEFINED SPATIAL REFERENCE SYSTEMS Statement](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/b115a75df4e342c1b7f960eba56f5be3.html)  
- [CREATE SPATIAL UNIT OF MEASURE Statement](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/c57e5b70b7084f08a5e569ae70d95b83.html)  
- [SAP Note 3331152 - Change of SRS and UOM Ownership](https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3331152)

### 2023-03-31 · AutoML polynomial feature generation

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2023.04 (QRC 1/2023) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248672*

AutoML now can generate polynomial and interaction features in classification and regression scenarios. The polynomial feature operator can automatically generate a feature table consisting of all polynomial combinations of features with degree between MIN_DEGREE and MAX_DEGREE. Additional inputs are required from users including MIN_DEGREE, MAX_DEGREE, INTERACTION_ONLY, and INCLUDE_BIAS. Because of the potential performance impact, this polynomial feature operator is not included in the lightweight configuration.  
See [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/d1a54bc3a4664937b77e85a865754b17.html) and [Pipeline Operator](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/fd58a3f156a24d80af2791ae60fb27bb.html).

### 2022-12-21 · Random Convolutional Kernel Transform

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2022.42 (QRC 4/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248679*

Random Convolutional Kernel Transform (ROCKET) is an exceptionally efficient algorithm for time series classification. Unlike other proposed time series classification algorithms which attain excellent accuracy, ROCKET maintains its performance with a fraction of the computational expense by transforming input time series using random convolutional kernels. Only a simple classifier is enough to train the transformed features and render the state-of-the-art accuracy.  
See [ROCKET](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/07c9a8cdba6a46039e2a7870896b185e.html).

*Area: Development · Type: New · Category: Calculation Views · Version: 2022.42 (QRC 4/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248784*

You can now apply filters to both partners of a join. Filters that are applied to one join partner can also be applied to mapped columns of the other join partner.  
Filter Mapping can be defined in each join node.

*Area: Administration · Type: New · Category: Partitioning · Version: 2022.42 (QRC 4/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248969*

Dynamic Range Partitioning has been enhanced by the addition of dynamic aging which makes it possible to automatically manage at which point in time older partitions can be moved to the 'warm' data store.  
See [Dynamic Aging](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/97e7c96f8a9d43ed90fc448c0d0b7f09.html)  

### 2022-12-21 · Default parameter value changes

*Area: Development · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2022.42 (QRC 4/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248683*

- Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree:  
- Changed the default value of SPLIT_METHOD to histogram and FEATURE_GROUPING to 1.  
- Added a new parameter FG_MIN_ZERO_RATE with a default value of 0.5 as the benchmark to identify whether or not a feature is a sparse feature.  
- Random Decision Tree: Changed the default value of MODEL_FORMAT to 1 (JSON).  
- Unified classification: Changed the default value of:  
- THREAD_RATIO to 1  
- JSON_EXPORT to 1 for multi-class logistic regression  
- model_format to 1 for RDT  
- K-Means and Accelerated K-Means: Changed the default value of USE_FAST_LIBRARY to 1.  
- Unified Regression: Changed the default value of JSON_EXPORT to 1.  
- Changed the default value of THREAD_RATIO to 1 for the following methods:  
- Multiple Linear Regression  
- Bi-Variate Geometric Regression  
- Exponential Regression  
- Polynomial Regression  
- Online Linear Regression  
- Logistic Regression (with Elastic Net Regularization)  
- Multi-Class Logistic Regression  
- Online Multi-Class Logistic Regression  
- Categorical Principal Component Analysis  
- Variance Test  
- ABC Analysis  
- Changed the default value of THREAD_RATIO to -1 for the following methods:  
- Unified classification  
- Unified regression  
- Unified exponential smoothing  

### 2022-12-21 · Cascading hints in the CALL statement

*Area: Reference · Action: Info only · Type: Changed · Category: SQLScript · Version: 2022.42 (QRC 4/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · Software_Lifecycle: General Availability · SAP-ID 595248648*

The CALL statement now supports the cascading of hints into internal SQL statements after optimization. When there are nested CALL statements, CASCADE hints are also propagated into the nested procedures.

You can now quickly find out where elements in a calculation view, such as calculated columns, input parameters, restricted columns, or variables, are used.  
[Where Used Functionality](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/d79577f0cda74f4faa1ba5a8b0a6ba45.html)  

### 2022-06-21 · Time Series Missing Value Handling (new function)

*Area: Development · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2022.16 (QRC 2/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248693*

The function is used to replace the missing values from a given multi-dimentional time series. It provides multiple imputation options for the users:  
- 0: NONE  
- 1: MODE_ALLZERO  
- 2: MODE_MEAN  
- 3: MODE_MEDIAN  
- 4: MODE_SMA  
- 5: MODE_LMA  
- 6: MODE_EMA  
- 7: MODE_LINTERP  
- 8: MODE_SINTERP  
- 9: MODE_SEADEC  
- 10: MODE_LOCF  
- 11: MODE_NOCB  
See [Time Series Missing Value Handling](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/368f7552f80a4130b3105b188766a1cf.html)

The workload class properties Statement Thread Limit and Total Statement Thread Limit are now supported for use in hierarchical classes.

### 2022-06-21 · Support for granting roles using role group

In the Role Assignment and Role Management apps, role group operators can now specify the role group as the granting principal when assigning roles that belong to a role group to users or roles.This feature is not available for SAP HANA service for SAP HANA BTP.  

### 2022-06-21 · Successive halving based parameter search

*Area: Development · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2022.16 (QRC 2/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248692*

Successive halving and hyperband are new fast parameter search mechanisms introduced in PAL cross validation and parameter search feature.  
It is enabled for the following algorithms:  
- Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree  
- K-Nearest Neighbor  
- Support Vector Machine  
- Multiple Linear Regression  
The following new options are added for the parameter RESAMPLING_METHOD:  
- cv_sha  
- cv_hyperband  
- stratified_cv_sha  
- stratified_cv_hyperband  
- bootstrap_sha  
- bootstrap_hyperband  
- stratified_bootstrap_sha  
- stratified_bootstrap_hyperband  
See [Model Evaluation and Parameter Selection](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/aadf7b8fded44f93a426e4c18faaf3eb.html)

*Area: Reference · Type: New · Category: Graph · Version: 2022.16 (QRC 2/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248367*

The keyword COLUMN is optional.  
See [CREATE GRAPH WORKSPACE Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/11afa2e60a5f4192a381df30f94863f9/e6e1c7e2b9064b05b26572808f941ec4.html)

### 2022-03-24 · TSB method

*Area: Development · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248703*

The Croston TSB method (for Teunter, Syntetos & Babai) is a forecast strategy for products with intermittent demand. It is a modification of Croston's method. It replaces the demand interval in Croston's method by demand probability which is updated every period. Compared to Croston's method, the forecast of TSB method is not biased and its probability forecast can be used to estimate the risk of obsolescence.  
See [Croston TSB Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/82038471a3294627a6838f625dcdc2cd.html)  

### 2022-03-24 · Stationarity test

*Area: Development · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248704*

This function is used to identify whether a time series is stationary by two optional statistical tests: Kwiatkowski-Phillips-Schmidt-Shin (KPSS) test and Augmented Dickey Fuller (ADF) test. Other than the common level-stationarity, this function can also detect the trend-stationarity which denotes the time series fluctuates around a deterministic trend.  
See [Stationarity Test](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/1d85b078fd194fa086058d46c502cac2.html)

### 2022-03-24 · SAML and JWT authentication with automatic user creation

*Area: Security · Type: New · Category: Authentication · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248921*

It is now possible to configure SAML and JWT identity providers for automatic user creation in conjunction with LDAP group authorization. This means that if you use an LDAP-compliant directory server to manage users and their access to resources, you can now leverage this infrastructure to provision the database users required for SAML- and JWT-authenticated users.  
A database user can be automatically created for a SAML-/JWT-authenticated user if the user exists in your LDAP server and this user is a member of at least one LDAP group mapped to at least one SAP HANA role.  
See:  
- [Single Sign-On Using SAML 2.0](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/db6db355bb571014b56eb25057daec5f.html)  
- [Single Sign-On Using JSON Web Tokens](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/4b3dc4d4b5514dbd9d45cee7bc167c5a.html)  
- [Configure SAML or JWT Authentication with LDAP-Based User Provisioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/8a0c391b1b104f8b8e9b0ccb74155390.html)

### 2022-03-24 · Plan Stability

*Area: Administration · Type: New · Category: SQL Plan Cache · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248986*

The Plan Stability feature has been introduced to SAP HANA Cloud and can be used to guarantee the consistent optimal performance of select statements by capturing query execution plans so that exactly the same plan can be reused when the query is executed again.  
Plan Stability now also includes a test mode which can be used to enable a saved plan for just the current session rather than for the system as a whole.  
See [SQL Plan Stability](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/deab4aee414e4b00a3df5666a44adfff.html)

X.509 certificates issued by a trusted identity provider can now be used to authenticate users connecting to remote SAP HANA on-premise systems and other SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA databases. ### 2022-03-24 · Missing value handling in Unified Regression and Unified Classification

*Area: Development · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248705*

Adding the following missing value handling types in the Unified Regression and Unified Classification method, both pivoted and unpivoted functions are supported.  
- MODE: Fills all missing values by the mode of the column, that is, the value that appears most often in the column. This type only suits column with categorical variables.  
- NONE: Does nothing. Leave the column untouched.  
- MEDIAN: Fills all missing values by the median of the column, that is, the value that separates the higher half of the non-missing values from the lower half. If there is an even number of observations, then the median is given by the mean of the two middle values. This type only suits column with numerical variables.MEAN: Fills all missing values by the mean of the column, that is, the average of all non-missing values in the column. This type only suits column with numerical variables.  
- ALS: Fills each missing value by the value imputed by a matrix completion model trained using alternating least squares method. This type only suits column with numerical variables.  
- SPECIFIED_CATEGORICAL_VALUE: Fills all missing values by a specified categorical value. This type only suits column with categorical variables.  
- SPECIFIED_NUMERICAL_VALUE: Fills all missing values by a specified numerical value. This type only suits column with numerical variables.  
- DELETE: Deletes all rows with missing values. The entire row in table will be deleted.  
- MEAN: Fills all missing values by the mean of the column,NONE: Does nothing. Leave the column untouched.  
See:  
- [Unified Classification with Pivoted Input Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/5f37c0a5129d4b5dad92a8b3fbb7fdd3.html)  
- [Unified Classification](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/8bd88cf29d9a45d0b52daad2653290d4.html)  
- [Unified Regression with Pivoted Input Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/3fdd71536c8444b6adb8ab15b0f2288d.html)  
- [Unified Regression](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/736b679c747f44279a481c10734ca25c.html)

### 2022-03-24 · Grid Generator Functions

*Area: Reference · Type: New · Category: Spatial · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248545*

Grid generators create tables with geometries. The created geometries cover given geometries.  
See:  
- [ST_HexagonGrid Function](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/88c39ce4ca494ed89a5c1ed18a57a0e3.html) generates a grid consisting of hexagon cells.

*Area: Development · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248709*

SAP HANA Graph provides the Dijkstra's Algorithm (DIJKSTRA). The description of the graph traversal statements has been reworked.  
See [Graph Traversal Statements](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/11afa2e60a5f4192a381df30f94863f9/2bd40d9848124781b27a37ce66344730.html)  

### 2022-03-24 · Default user group for new users

*Area: Security · Type: New · Category: User Management · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248920*

The new SET USERGROUP statement allows you to specify the user group to which all users created within the current session are automatically added. You do not have to specify the role group explicitly for every new user (until you execute the UNSET USERGROUP statement).See [SET USERGROUP](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/19918539993849888af17415d43382b5.html) and [UNSET USERGROUP](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/996f99709bfa4037a9dcce812b6d57d9.html).  

### 2022-03-24 · Data Preview

*Area: Administration · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Database Explorer · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 592117568*

The Data Preview editor for dimension calculation views and CUBE calculation views now contains a Hierarchies tab that shows hierarchies and measures details if they are available for the view. For more information about the new Hierarchies tab, see "[Preview Calculation View Output](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/3746eb56b77943b699df025ab2bc7552/903eff885ebd4c5cadb1e0c3e58f681d.html)" in the SAP HANA Modeling Guide.

### 2022-03-24 · CARDINALITY Function for Arrays

*Area: Reference · Type: New · Category: JSON Document Store · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248383*

The CARDINALITY function returns the number of elements in a specified array.  
See [SELECT](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f2d68919a1ad437fac08cc7d1584ff56/991ab0d69db542e992a61b4b40f348e8.html)  

### 2022-03-24 · AutoML

*Area: Development · Type: New · Category: Predictive Analysis Library · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248702*

The AutoML feature exposes new pipeline functions for composing a sequence of multiple PAL function calls and then build the best pipeline models automatically. It covers automation of data preprocessing, model-fitting, comparison and optimization for scenarios like classification, regression.  
Users have the choice to either use a default or a customized configuration to run the AutoML functions. Specific functions are provided to allow the user to view or change the configuration.  
Shipped AutoML functions:  
- PAL_PIPELINE_FIT  
- PAL_PIPELINE_PREDICT  
- PAL_AUTOML_CONFIG  
- PAL_AUTOML_FIT  
See:  
- [Pipeline](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/de964934276b415aa6ae0c71ce72f351.html)  
- [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/d1a54bc3a4664937b77e85a865754b17.html)  

### 2022-03-24 · Admission Control

*Area: Administration · Type: Changed · Category: Workload Classes · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248985*

The default value of the admission control CPU queuing parameter (queue_cpu_threshold) has been changed. The parameter was previously set to 0 (and the feature was therefore disabled by default). The new setting of 90% means that the feature is now enabled by default and the workload class will queue new requests if the load on the system reaches 90% of available CPU capacity until the load on the system reduces.  
See [Workload Classes and Admission Control](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/72cd0d40bbe04ee0a353a4e622b8d320.html)  

### 2022-03-24 · ALTER TABLE statement

*Area: Reference · Type: Changed · Category: SQL · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248901*

Non-heterogeneous partitioned tables now support the AT LOCATION clause with the MERGE PARTITIONS clause. See [Non-heterogeneous Alter Partition Clauses](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/f7ae27ca1b954471a4e1a7feab2c24d7.html).

*Area: Reference · Type: Changed · Category: SQL · Version: 2022.04 (QRC 1/2022) · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 595248903*

Within the GRANT and REVOKE statements, when granting roles in a role group, the USING GROUP clause allows the role group, instead of the executing user, to be the grantor. System views have been updated to include role group as a valid grantor type.  
See:  
- [GRANT Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20f674e1751910148a8b990d33efbdc5.html)

- [EFFECTIVE_ROLES System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20a3229a75191014a9f0893bb1ea23d5.html)  
- [EFFECTIVE_ROLE_GRANTEES System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/d2beddd316ae4164925d4c0d7385d298.html)

*Area: Administration · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Database Explorer · Version: Version independent · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: Data Lake · SAP-ID 592117542*

### 2022-02-27 · Manage Services

*Area: Monitoring · Type: Changed · Category: SAP HANA Cockpit · Version: Version independent · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 592117522*

The Failover Group column has been added. To achieve high availability, instance services are grouped into failover groups. The value in this column indicates whether the source and replica services in failover groups are set up in the same or different zones.  

### 2022-02-27 · Compare Database Configuration

*Area: Administration · Type: Changed · Category: SAP HANA Cockpit · Version: Version independent · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 592117514*

In the Database Configuration app, you can now select more than one database in order to compare the configuration of multiple databases at the same time.  
See [Compare Configurations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9630e508caef4578b34db22014998dba/9d6cb0f89ab24d90923e2be97c13e080.html).  

### 2022-02-13 · Application Managed Service Instances

*Area: Administration · Type: Changed · Category: SAP HANA Database Explorer · Version: Version independent · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 592117567*

When adding Application Managed Service Instances, support for Instance Manager is being deprecated. The Manager drop-down for Application Managed Service Instances currently includes entries for both service and instance managers. Once Instance Manager is no longer supported, only Service Managers will appear in the drop-down.

*Area: Administration · Type: New · Category: SAP HANA Database Explorer · Version: Version independent · Environment: Cloud Foundry · Component: SAP HANA Database · SAP-ID 592117572*

You can now remove multiple databases simultaneously by clicking the  (Open the remove databases dialog) icon above the catalog browser on the left of the screen.  
See [Remove Databases from the SAP HANA Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/53f7321706244b499797682b758f5422.html).

In the Backup Catalog app, it is now possible to see whether or not a data backup includes configuration (INI) files.This feature is not available for SAP HANA service for SAP HANA BTP.
